definitions.gloss: to prohibit, to forbid, to ban
definitions.explanation: To officially or authoritatively forbid something. Used for rules, laws, and regulations.

definitions.gloss: to suppress, to hold back (an emotion)
definitions.explanation: To restrain oneself from expressing a feeling. Most commonly appears in the set phrase ...を{禁|きん}じ{得|え}ない (cannot help but feel...).

examples.japanese: {喫煙|きつえん}を{禁|きん}じる。
この{地域|ちいき}では{釣|つ}りが{禁|きん}じられている。
examples.english: Fishing is prohibited in this area.

examples.japanese: {法律|ほうりつ}で{未成年者|みせいねんしゃ}の{飲酒|いんしゅ}は{禁|きん}じられている。
examples.english: Drinking by minors is prohibited by law.

examples.japanese: {涙|なみだ}を{禁|きん}じ{得|え}なかった。
examples.english: I could not hold back my tears.

examples.japanese: {驚|おどろ}きを{禁|きん}じ{得|え}ない。
examples.english: I cannot help but feel astonished.

examples.japanese: その{悲惨|ひさん}な{状況|じょうきょう}を{見|み}て、{同情|どうじょう}の{念|ねん}を{禁|きん}じ{得|え}なかった。
examples.english: Seeing that tragic situation, I could not help but feel sympathy.

notes:
USAGE:
An ichidan verb. The variant {禁|きん}ずる (classical form) also exists but {禁|きん}じる is standard in modern Japanese.

Sense 2 almost always appears in the fixed pattern ～を{禁|きん}じ{得|え}ない (cannot suppress, cannot help but feel). This is a formal, written expression.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {喫煙|きつえん}を{禁|きん}じる: to prohibit smoking
- {法律|ほうりつ}で{禁|きん}じる: to prohibit by law
- {涙|なみだ}を{禁|きん}じ{得|え}ない: cannot hold back tears
- {驚|おどろ}きを{禁|きん}じ{得|え}ない: cannot help but be amazed
